full_details: An hour before he spoke, Kettleby's boy had already brought it. The Queen came up from Richmond yesterday. My lord of Huntingdon is dead in the north, and she would tell the Countess herself. The court is at Whitehall. Heminges has Davy Gannet's tilt-boat for Wednesday's flood, and a deposit down, and he did not say the sum. You had it that she goes back Monday, and that the players are looked for at Richmond as appointed. If she does not go, you follow her, and there is a second deposit, also unspoken. At two you were Chorus and the Prince, the fourth time. At the reckoning nobody ruled a line under the week. Three nights are looked for and not received. Two cloaks are still out till Innocents' night. Eleven pair of hose are drying, and drying was not entered as money. The new moon has no hour on the almanac. You did not count the coffer.
one_sentence: Heminges called with the court at Whitehall, you told him the Queen goes back Monday, and you played the lovers a fourth time under a new moon.
title: Told Heminges the Queen goes back Monday
